voltorb.introText: Flip Voltorb is a mix between Picross and Minesweeper. Your goal is to find the multiplier cards without flipping any Voltorb.
boardItems: The game takes place on a 5×5 grid.
Under each tile hides a number (1, 2 or 3) or a Voltorb.
The numbers are multipliers that increase your coins.
The Voltorbs make you lose all coins from the current round.
playSteps: Click on a tile to flip it.
If you find a multiplier (x2 or x3), your coins are multiplied by that value.
If it's the first card you flip, you get that number of coins.
If you find a Voltorb, you lose all coins from the round and the game ends.
You can choose Cash out at any time to save your coins and move to the next level.
levelItems: You win and advance by finding all x2 and x3 cards.
Higher levels have more multipliers and Voltorbs, increasing risk and reward.
Regression rule: if at the end of the round you have flipped fewer multiplier cards than your current level number, you will drop to that level.
voltorb.level8Text: To reach level 8, you must win 5 consecutive games at any level, flipping 8 or more multiplier cards in each of these 5 games.
voltorb.memoModeText: You can use Memo mode to mark tiles with symbols (Voltorb, 1, 2 or 3) without flipping them. This helps you remember your suspicions about each tile's contents.
tipItems: Use the row and column information to deduce the location of multipliers and Voltorbs.
Sometimes it's better to cash out and move to the next level than risk losing everything.
Use Memo mode to mark your suspicions and strategies.
Practice and develop your intuition to improve at the game.

voltorb.levelCompleteText: You found all multipliers without triggering any Voltorb!
